written: after the first exp1 run (exp1_results.json), before the diagnostics below were computed. The first run showed: 0/14 starts inside the policy's training support in every variant (tool-y offset 0-1 cm vs box 0.95-3.95 cm); the policy leaves the success region again if run on to 200 steps; GO_day diverges on 4/10; goal cp vs the day's hover cp median 11.6 mm. These are post-hoc diagnostics, not confirmatory.
a_hover_geometry: for the 10 attempts with a hover reference: u = R_hover^T (hover.cp - cp_grasp) in mm, cp_grasp = p*_ecm - R_hover TCP (affine mapping). If the day's hover were 'grasp backed off along tool -z' u would be (0,0,-h). Report u, |u_xy| (lateral), u_z, and the height of the kinematic tip above p* along the pad normal. This is the error of the goal CONSTRUCTION (reference + calibration + TCP + standoff convention), independent of the policy.
b_staged_start: start pose solved INSIDE the support (plan_r6_start.solve_start_pose logic, rebuilt): R_start = R_goal @ Rel^-1, p_start = p_goal - R_start @ offset_mean_cm/100, with offset_mean = R6_START_OFFSET_TOOL_MEAN and Rel = rotvec(R6_START_TO_GOAL_ROTVEC_MEAN). Goals: GO_day (10 attempts) and GO_rel (14), standoff 7 mm, jaw start 0.76, affine. Report first-success step and d_goal / rot_goal at first success and whether the success rule is met within 200 steps. Whether the real arm can reach such a start is NOT assessed.
c_regression: run the policy from the checkpoint's own representative pair R6_REPRESENTATIVE_START_VEC7 -> R6_REPRESENTATIVE_GOAL_VEC7 (policy frame, direct, no bridge) and from 20 starts = representative start + N(0, 5 mm / 5 deg) noise (seed 20261016): count success within 200 steps. This checks that the rollout code reproduces working behaviour in distribution (contract reports 46/50 for its own demo starts; a handful of draws is only a sanity check, not a reproduction of that number).
